sourcePresentation.shortUnitExponentColorRole: unit; the suffix belongs to the complete unit token
sourcePresentation.example: In 2m2 displayed as 2m², m and ² have the same unit color; the leading 2 has the number color
sourcePresentation.explicitPower: In 2m^2, the right operand 2 remains a number
sourcePresentation.sourcePreservation: automatic exponent styling does not alter the source text or add an undo action
sourcePresentation.undoTyping: undo the latest committed input or deletion, not the entire series of typing
sourcePresentation.undoPaste: one paste, including multiple lines, is one undo action
sourcePresentation.composition: intermediate composition updates are not separate committed inputs

unitTargets.shape: unit atom, optionally followed by / and a second unit atom; only already supported final dimensions
unitTargets.atoms: registered units and the accepted square/cubic length forms

lengthPowers.caretSpelling: not an alternative target-unit spelling; suggest the corresponding superscript form

unitTargets.arithmeticInsideTarget: no numerical factors or addition/multiplication expressions inside the target
unitTargets.nextConversion: to or :: starts the next step of the existing left-to-right conversion chain
unitTargets.precedence: unchanged; spaces do not change precedence
unitTargets.otherTargetKinds: existing numeral-system and calendar/UTC rules remain separate and unchanged

unitCompletion.candidateForm: continuations of the typed unit prefix, not merely a repeated exact m entry with two meanings
unitCompletion.filter: operation-sensitive compatibility in the local expression and constraints propagated through outer parentheses and operations

lengthAdditionExample.meaning: complete a length addend; | marks the caret and is not formula syntax

unitCompletion.typingVsPresence: the mere presence of a length does not rule out a time divisor; apply operation/type rules
unitCompletion.durationAddition: the previously accepted addition of durations remains valid
unitCompletion.locale: Latin baseline plus only the active interface locale; calendar month is mon/мес, with no former short spelling alias
unitCompletion.layoutAndKeys: existing seven-row inline layout, prefix dimming, descriptions, Tab and arrow-key precedence remain applicable
unitCompletion.outerContextExample: 1cm + (2m… * 3) suggests compatible length continuations; ellipsis indicates unfinished input, not formula syntax
unitCompletion.incompleteContext: retain every prefix continuation that cannot yet be ruled out; do not prematurely select one latent unit interpretation

conversionTargets.eligibility: compatible with at least one still-valid interpretation of the source value
conversionTargets.example: after 1m to, cm and s are possible targets; selecting a target adds that unit constraint
conversionTargets.deduplication: do not duplicate identical inserted spellings
conversionTargets.insertion: insert visible spelling without a hidden type selection
